parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  t.id,
  t.title,
  t.description,
  t.status,
  t.priority,
  t.work_group,
  t.due_date,
  t.start_date,
  t.completed_date,
  u.id as assignee_id,
  u.email as assignee_email,
  u.full_name as assignee_name,
  u.username as assignee_username,
  creator.id as creator_id,
  creator.email as creator_email,
  creator.full_name as creator_name,
  supervisor.id as supervisor_id,
  supervisor.email as supervisor_email,
  supervisor.full_name as supervisor_name
FROM work_tasks t
LEFT JOIN work_tasks_assigned_to wta ON t.id = wta.worktask_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON wta.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN users creator ON t.created_by_id = creator.id
LEFT JOIN users supervisor ON t.supervisor_id = supervisor.id
WHERE t.id = CAST('{{ $json.task_id }}' AS BIGINT)
LIMIT 1

=SELECT log_workflow_execution('{{ $node["Format Notifications"].json.workflow_name }}', '{{ $node["Format Notifications"].json.execution_id }}', 'Send Status Change Notifications', 'notification', 'success', '{{ JSON.stringify({task_id: $node["Format Notifications"].json.task_id, status_change: $node["Format Notifications"].json.old_status + " -> " + $node["Format Notifications"].json.new_status}) }}'::jsonb, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL) as log_id

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "success": true, "message": "Task status change notifications sent", "task_id": $node["Format Notifications"].json.task_id, "status": $node["Format Notifications"].json.new_status, "notifications_sent": { "mattermost": true, "email": $node["Format Notifications"].json.recipients.length } } }}
